premises.text: High clothing return rates stem from design and fit practices that ignore most body shapes, not size alone
premises.evidence_span: How can one third of clothing be returned because it doesn't fit?

premises.text: Shape-filter technology uses AI classification of garment design details plus a UI that captures shopper shape and proportion to recommend clothes that will look right on her body
premises.evidence_span: We make recommendations on clothing for an individual body shape and proportion using the design details in an individual garment

premises.text: Enterprise implementation plugs into retailer inventory systems under an annual contract with upfront fee plus percentage of sales
premises.evidence_span: We have an annual contract with an upfront fee and a percentage of sales

value.text: Shoppers find clothes that fit their body shape easily while retailers raise sales and cut returns

causal_links.evidence_span: The problem with returns is more than just a size or a measurement issue
narrowed it down to what works for her, making her shopping a whole lot easier
increase your sales, decrease your returns
